scenarios.title: Brushing teeth at bedtime
scenarios.setting: Bathroom, 7:45 pm, already late for bed
scenarios.openingLine: NO! I don't want to brush my teeth!

planPhrases.phrase: You really don't want bedtime to start, huh?
Top teeth first or bottom teeth first?
When teeth are sparkly, then we read your story.

scenarios.title: Leaving the playground
scenarios.trigger: doesn't want to leave the playground
scenarios.setting: Park, 5:30 pm, time to go home for dinner
scenarios.openingLine: No! I'm not going! I want to SLIDE!

planPhrases.phrase: You love the slide so much. It's hard to stop.
One more slide or two more swings, then we go?
Want to hop to the car like a bunny?

scenarios.title: Getting dressed for daycare
scenarios.setting: Bedroom, 7:50 am, you need to leave in 10 minutes
scenarios.openingLine: I'm NOT wearing that! It's itchy!

planPhrases.phrase: That shirt feels itchy and you hate that feeling.
The red shirt or the soft blue one?
Let's race: can you get dressed before I count to ten?

scenarios.title: Turning off the tablet
scenarios.trigger: won't stop playing on the tablet
scenarios.setting: Living room, 6 pm, dinner is ready
scenarios.openingLine: Just one more level! You promised!

planPhrases.phrase: It's so hard to stop right in the middle of a level.
Do you want to save it now or after this round?
When dinner is done, then you can tell me about the level.

scenarios.title: Fighting over a toy
scenarios.trigger: screaming because a sibling took a toy
scenarios.openingLine: She TOOK it! It's MINE! It's not fair!

planPhrases.phrase: You're so upset. That toy really matters to you.
I won't let anyone grab. I'll hold it while we figure it out.
Do you want to set a timer or trade toys?

scenarios.title: Homework meltdown
scenarios.setting: Kitchen table, 7 pm, worksheet due tomorrow
scenarios.openingLine: I can't do this! It's too hard! I'm not doing it!

planPhrases.phrase: Math feels really frustrating right now.
I'm right here. Let's do just the first problem together.
Want to start with the easiest one or the shortest one?

scenarios.title: Getting ready for school
scenarios.trigger: won't get out of bed and get dressed
scenarios.setting: Bedroom, 7:35 am, the school bus comes in 15 minutes
scenarios.openingLine: I'm not going! I hate mornings! Just five more minutes!

planPhrases.phrase: You really don't want to leave your warm bed, huh?
Do you want to wear the hoodie or the jacket?
When you're dressed, then you pick the music in the car.

scenarios.title: Phone away at bedtime
scenarios.trigger: won't hand over the phone at bedtime
scenarios.openingLine: Seriously? Everyone else is still online. You're ruining my life.

planPhrases.phrase: It feels so unfair to log off while your friends are still online.
Do you want to plug it in yourself, or should I?
When the phone is charging in the kitchen, then we can talk about weekend hours.
